segments.name: Technology-based company
segments.description: Develops privacy-focused social media and messaging applications for consumers and businesses.
segments.evidence: The Company operates as a single operating segment as a technology-based company that is developing social media applications and technologies.

changes.text: In 2025, the Company sold its minority interest in RPM Interactive to Avalon and deconsolidated RPM, which was classified as discontinued operations.
changes.evidence: As a result of the closing, the Company no longer holds a controlling interest in and is no longer the primary beneficiary of RPM, which was a variable interest entity, and as of December 12, 2025, has deconsolidated RPM.

changes.text: In 2024, following the acquisition of RPM, the Company ceased development of the Habytat platform.
changes.evidence: As discussed above, following our acquisition of RPM in October 2024, we ceased our development of the Habytat platform.

changes.text: In 2024, the Company deconsolidated Metabizz SAS.
changes.evidence: On March 31, 2024, based on the Company's analysis, the Company deconsolidated Metabizz SAS (See Note 1).
